title: Magonia people arrested at Lyon, Agobard denies it

tellings.quote: where the whole Monagonia thing that Valet talks about. This is that period where you know you had these people supposedly coming from Mononia and some of them were arrested and then this bishop Agabard who was like a protorationalist came up with a justification for why this couldn't possibly be real.

plain: In Lyon, in France, people said to have come from a place called Magonia were supposedly arrested, and a bishop named Agobard argued that it could not possibly be real. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells Michels this in passing. He gives no source of his own, but ties it to the UFO writer Jacques Vallée, and he calls Agobard an early rationalist, which makes it a story about how strange visitors were explained away long ago.
